blocks.text: Employer details for the IRS notice response
Demonstration document. Not for filing or payment.
Entity type: Washington limited liability company taxed as a C corporation
Business address: 2150 Harbor Ridge Ave S, Suite 300, Seattle, WA 98134
Officers: Celeste Whitford, President and CEO (60% shareholder); Riley Tanaka, Vice President (40% shareholder); Jordan Hale, CFO; Dana Whitfield, Controller
Authorized to sign for the company: Celeste Whitford, President
Pay schedule: Biweekly, every other Friday, for two-week periods ending the Sunday before; off-cycle runs for bonuses
Payroll system: In-house payroll system run by the controller; it initiates one EFTPS deposit for each regular payroll and prepares Form 941 in its return module
Deposit timing in the payroll system: Each regular payroll is deposited by EFTPS on the next business day after the payday; every 2026 payday has carried $100,000 or more of tax
Off-cycle runs: Not in the automatic EFTPS batch: the controller schedules each off-cycle deposit by hand in EFTPS
Form 941 depositor setting in the payroll system return module: Monthly schedule depositor since the system upgrade of May 4, 2026, which reset it from semiweekly; not yet corrected
Federal tax deposits: All by EFTPS
Power of attorney: No Form 2848 or Form 8821 on file for F1 Finance
Prepared by the controller on October 29, 2026, the day the notice arrived. Not signed.
